messages:
Ravi (infra): FYI: staggered KMS key policy tighten at 02:40UTC appears to have broken node bootstrap in us-west-2. ~9 GPU nodes stuck in Terminated/NotReady during init. error in kubelet: `failed to decrypt disk key: AccessDenied`
Marta (sre): hitting it too. worker-startup logs show repeated calls to keystore service which returns 403 for the node role. Also saw a spike in NAT gateway errors shortly after: `TLS handshake failed` on log shipping path.
deploy-bot: rollout:keystore-policy v4 -> v5 merged by ash at 02:37UTC
security-ash: that policy was to restrict cross-account decryption after last quarter's audit. we scoped down a principal but maybe the instance profile ARN changed in the ASG LT last week.
Luca (platform): cross-checking launch-template history now. found LT v12 that replaced instance profile arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/old-node-role -> arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/new-node-role (rolled 3 days ago). Keystore policy expects old-node-role.
Priya (oncall): what about the pending GPUs? can they be reprovisioned quickly? Customers are seeing elevated 99p latency for embeddings.
Ravi (infra): short-term plan: 1) roll keystore policy to include new-node-role as delegated principal (emergency) 2) patch LT to revert to old-node-role (if easier) 3) requeue failed node boots with a drain/recreate
Marta (sre): also, logs show that when nodes repeatedly failed, the logshipper queue filled and NAT SNAT ports exhausted on the egress NAT instance which caused TCP resets and some PutObject failures to audit S3. backlog ~45k items now.
security-ash: I can sign an emergency allow for new-node-role for 45 minutes if infra files a ticket and we enable enhanced audit logs for keystore and S3 buckets. We'll need a postmortem and a compensating control: enable KMS key rotation logs and keep CloudTrail retention at 90 days for the affected principals.
Luca (platform): I can kick a targeted LT rollout to revert the profile in 5m. That will prevent new nodes from hitting keystore, but existing stuck nodes still need restart/recreate.
Priya (oncall): I'll scale down the ASG temporarily to stop churn and avoid more NAT exhaustion. reduce desired to current healthy count.
Ravi (infra): created ticket INFRA-5590 referencing keystore-policy emergency + audit artifacts. attaching CloudTrail snippets.
Marta (sre): if we can't fix keystore quickly, fallback: we can mount an EBS volume with decrypted keys copied from a secure volunteer host, but that is manual and risky. prefer policy change.
security-ash: preferred path is scoped exception. I'll post ACL update in INFRA-5590 with exact ARN allow and expiration.
deploy-bot: action:deployment paused affected=us-west-2-keystore-policy reason=hotfix_blocker
Luca (platform): done reverting LT instance profile on a canary ASG; monitoring node join. will schedule rolling revert for other ASGs after safety window.
Priya (oncall): NAT port usage dropped after scale down, S3 PutObject retries started succeeding again for some items. backlog drain rate ~900/s.
Ravi (infra): after security approval, we'll patch keystore policy and run a controlled reboot on the 9 stuck nodes to let them fetch decrypted keys. expect ~10-15m to join.
Marta (sre): follow-up: add a CI precheck that compares policy principals vs cloud infra changes in LT/ASG before merging policy changes. prevents the merge-without-alpha check mismatch.
security-ash: agree. I'll also add a checklist to policy PRs to validate instance profile ARNs in active launch templates. small ops but big safety.
Ravi (infra): thanks all. will update INFRA-5590 when nodes are green. once stable we should run a retrospective about simultaneous changes to identity and network flow limits.
Priya (oncall): keeping an eye on customer latency and cost metric for GPU spinners. ping me if >150ms 99p.
Luca (platform): nodes recovering on canary now, +6 joined. patching the rest in waves.
Marta (sre): marking incident as mitigated for now; will collect logs for postmortem.
Ravi (infra): final note: we should also increase NAT gateway scaling headroom or move shippers to use VPC endpoints for S3 to avoid SNAT port pressure during boot storms.
